content.comment_body: Hello, I have a 24V DC [product_name] device that my instructor loaned me for testing. However, I am unable to start my work because a program is already running on it and I don't know how to reset it. The device has only 'esc' and 'OK' buttons, and pressing them doesn't seem to have any effect. Sorry if this is a basic question, but I am new to this. Can anyone provide guidance?

Hi, To access programming mode, press the 'right', 'left', and 'OK' buttons at the same time. This will bring up a menu where you can reset the current program. All the best. [user_name] [company_name] Ltd. A&D - Marketing Delhi Ph: [personal_info] Fax: [personal_info] Mob: [personal_info]

analysis.insight_summary: A user struggled to reset a running program on a [product_name] device due to unclear instructions and restricted button functionality. Feedback identified that device navigation may not be intuitive for new users, which can lead to confusion about operational controls and managing programs. This discussion points to usability challenges with the interface for beginners.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is looking for a simple and clear method to reset or remove a running program directly from the device's interface, especially since they are inexperienced and working independently.
